newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank of Portugal gov says EMU entry "achievable'.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Portugal gov says EMU entry "achievable'.

text.p: Bank of Portugal governor Antonio de Sousa said on Tuesday that it was perfectly "achievable" for Portugal to be amongst the first group of countries in monetary union.
"(The entry of Portugal)...is perfectly within our reach," de Sousa said a speech at a ceremony marking the 150th anniversary of the Bank of Portugal.
"To achieve it...we need to continue with the macro-economic policies that have enabled Portugal to become a candidate," he said.
De Sousa said that Portugal could meet the economic entry tests set for Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), which is due to be launched in January 1999.
